title: Property manager’s AI promised a rent extension, but tenant was evicted
teaser: A North Carolina resident, Laura Mack, has filed a lawsuit seeking to overturn her eviction. She says the property management company sent her a letter allowing her to pay $4,000 in overdue rent by November 30, then evicted her anyway. According to WRAL News, the letter was written by Olivia, an AI assistant for Colony Townhome Apartments’ management company. Staff said the AI granted the extension by mistake and without their knowledge; the letter did not warn Mack that she was communicating with AI.
